extraction.notes: IRT reports no AFFO; CFFO is the adjusted FFO metric and is reproduced from the three-months-ended Sep 30, 2024 column. Subtotals tie: 12,620 + 54,880 + 598 + 160 = 68,258 (FFO); 68,258 + 382 + 1,249 - 2,239 - 848 + 0 + 0 = 66,802 (CFFO). Shares 230,762,299 (weighted avg common shares and OP units) reproduce FFO/share $0.30 and CFFO/share $0.29. The FFO line 'Loss on impairment (gain on sale) ... excluding prepayment gains' is a combined impairment/gain line; categorized as property_sale_gain_loss. Prepayment (gains) penalties on asset dispositions categorized as 'other' since it is a prepayment item rather than a plain property sale gain. Recurring capex of $7.3 million is from the Capital Expenditures paragraph on page 3 (rounded in source) and is not subtracted in CFFO; no AFFO exists.
